invariants: caption changes expand to one frame per animation tick followed by one compressed hold
continuation shots with the same nonempty caption key carry text without reanimation
changed caption keys animate and cards reset caption carry state
enter animates the complete surface and clamps its animation window to sixty percent of shot duration
every hold lasts at least one frame and total duration never undercuts the storyboard
required terminal keyframes retain first-use order and remove duplicates

nativeAdaptation.types: Rust serde models replace the handwritten JavaScript declaration file and preserve camelCase frame-plan JSON.
nativeAdaptation.entrypoint: cargo xtask media plan reads an array or a shots object and emits the deterministic compositor plan without Node, Bun, or Playwright.
nativeAdaptation.coverage: Seven Rust tests translate all seven upstream tests; an additional CLI test executes file parsing, directory creation, planning, and JSON output.
